lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively equidistant in the central mass, with approximately 50-70 pixel intervals, narrowing slightly as they approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line segment is abbreviated, terminating at the mid-shoulder level. The 10th and 11th lines exhibit fragmentation, breaking into dashed segments and spots before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of approximately 8-10 high-contrast white spots is positioned on the lower posterior haunch, posterior to the final vertical line segment.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line approximately parallel to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings include a chevron-like patch between the eyes and two distinct circular spots on the cheek. High-contrast white bands are present on the upper-medial portion of the forelimbs and the lateral surface of the hindlimbs.
